lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots organized into roughly five horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill slits towards the caudal region, with clear equidistant spacing between individual nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity pixel bands intersect perpendicularly with horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct checkerboard-like lattice where white spots serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to a dark shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A cluster of approximately 10-15 high-luminance circular spots is distributed within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed near the anterior base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (likely symbiotic Echeneidae) attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
